```{r}
install.packages("RSQLite")
```

```{r}
getwd()
```


```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "midwest_airbnb.db")
listings = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings")

#How many listings
nrow(listings)
```

# How many of the listings are in Columbus?
```{r}
sum(listings$city == "Columbus")
```


# Most Expensive Listing 

```{r}
listings[listings$city == "Chicago", ][which.max(listings[listings$city == "Chicago", ]$price), "name"]
```


# how many distinct values does the neighbourhood column have

```{r}
length(unique(listings$neighbourhood[listings$city == "Chicago"]))
```


# how many listings are run by a superhost?

```{r}
sum(listings$host_is_superhost == "t", na.rm = TRUE)
```


# How many listings cost more than $1K per night?

```{r}
sum(listings$price > 1000)
```
